final_sql: SELECT Record_Company, Year_of_Founded FROM orchestra ORDER BY Year_of_Founded DESC LIMIT 100
answer:
Here are the record companies of the orchestras, from the most recent founding year to the earliest:

| Record company | Year founded |
|---|---|
| Columbia Masterworks | 2009 |
| Philips | 2008 |
| Philips Classics Records | 2008 |
| RCA | 2008 |
| EMI | 2007 |
| Koch Records / Naxos Records | 2006 |
| Decca Records | 2004 |
| Mercury Records | 2003 |
| Deutsche Grammophon | 2003 |
| Kultur | 2002 |
| Decca Records | 2002 |
| Delos Records | 2002 |

I read "years in which they were founded" as the `Year_of_Founded` column in the `orchestra` table. That column holds the year each orchestra was founded, not the record company.

Decca Records appears twice because two different orchestras use it, one founded in 2004 and one in 2002. Where years tie, the order within the tie is arbitrary.
